body.purpose: Base stack set on body; the compose input's 16px size is load-bearing because anything smaller makes iOS zoom the page. Tabular numerals are global.

glyph.purpose: The modifier and chord symbols printed on Apple keyboards. Typed characters, never drawn icons.

keycap.purpose: The face of a word key (Click, Right click). Weight 500 on wide keys.

readout.purpose: Connection status word, uppercase at 0.16em; also the plain 13px size for ghost buttons, settings labels and toggles.

legend.purpose: The ranked gesture legend on the pad: terms at 600, definitions at 400. Also isolated-key captions and settings values.

label.purpose: Uppercase keycap sublabels, host address (0.1em) and app tile names (0.02em, not uppercased).

section.purpose: Sheet titles. The widest tracking in the system (0.2em) and the only heading-like role.

shadows.name: indicator-glow
shadows.purpose: The live connection lamp. Zero-offset, so it reads as light rather than elevation.

shadows.name: engagement-glow
shadows.purpose: The trackpad border during an active drag.

shadows.name: engagement-ring
shadows.purpose: A latched modifier or held-Command key. The named signature; always accompanied by amber border, text and wash so the glow is never the only signal.

motion.name: step
motion.purpose: The system step (--step). Used only on the gesture flash's opacity. Nothing eases; state lands in two frames because easing reads as lag.

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.purpose: The one eased moment in the system: a sheet rising from translateY(110%) to 0.

motion.name: lamp-warm
motion.purpose: The one authored animation: the connection lamp warming from a zero-radius glow at 0.4 opacity to full when the link comes up.

motion.name: reduced-motion-gate
motion.purpose: All three motion tokens live inside this gate. With reduced motion, every state change is instant.

breakpoints.name: none
breakpoints.purpose: Single-surface iOS Safari client. No width breakpoints exist; the layout adapts through flex, env(safe-area-inset-*), 60vh/28vh caps and a JS pad floor (PAD_FLOOR = 150px) measured off visualViewport.

targets.name: primary
targets.purpose: --target: the floor for anything the thumb must hit in the main column.

targets.name: secondary
targets.purpose: Apple's own minimum; the floor for compact sheet keys, ghost buttons and the compose input.

components.name: Key
components.description: The system primitive: a field plate with a seam border and a guaranteed 52px target. Holds a hardware glyph, a sprite icon, a word, or an icon plus an uppercase caption.
components.css: .ds-key { min-height: 3.25rem; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.375rem; background: var(--field, #15161A); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); color: var(--ink, #E9E6DF); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key-glyph { font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-key-cap { font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-faint, #7C818B); } .ds-key:active { background: var(--field-down, #1F212733); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lamp, #FFB546); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Key, Engaged (the lamp ring)
components.description: The signature. A latched modifier or held Command wears amber border, text, wash, inset ring and outer glow for exactly as long as the state is held.
components.css: .ds-key-on { min-height: 3.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.375rem; background: var(--lamp-wash, rgba(255,181,70,0.07)); border: 1px solid var(--lamp, #FFB546); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); color: var(--lamp, #FFB546); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--lamp, #FFB546), 0 0 0.75rem var(--lamp-glow, rgba(255,181,70,0.30)); } .ds-key-on-glyph { font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-key-on-cap { font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--lamp, #FFB546); } .ds-key-on:active { background: var(--field-down, #1F212733); }

components.name: Key, Isolated
components.description: The outline variant for system-disrupting gestures and panel openers: transparent ground, seam border only, held apart from its neighbours by a 20px gap rather than a divider.
components.css: .ds-key-iso { min-height: 3.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.375rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); color: var(--ink, #E9E6DF); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key-iso svg { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; display: block; } .ds-key-iso-cap { font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-faint, #7C818B); } .ds-key-iso:active { background: var(--field-down, #1F212733); } .ds-key-iso:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lamp, #FFB546); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Sheet-only secondary action (Done, Refresh) at the 44px floor. Never used for anything that changes the Mac.
components.css: .ds-ghost { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); color: var(--ink-dim, #878D99); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-ghost svg { width: 1.0625rem; height: 1.0625rem; } .ds-ghost:active { background: var(--field-down, #1F212733); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lamp, #FFB546); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Trackpad
components.description: The product's centre: one large unmarked field with an engraved inner rule and a ranked gesture legend. Absorbs all spare height, never drops below its floor, and goes amber-bordered during a drag.
components.html:
One finger
move, tap to click
Two fingers
scroll, tap to right-click
Tap then hold
drag
components.css: .ds-pad { position: relative; min-height: 8.5rem; margin: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0; background: var(--field, #15161A); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; padding-top: 1rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-pad::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } .ds-pad-legend { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 0.45rem 0.875rem; padding: 0 1rem 1.125rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-pad-legend dt { justify-self: end; color: var(--ink-dim, #878D99); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-pad-legend dd { color: var(--ink-faint, #7C818B); } .ds-pad:active { border-color: var(--lamp, #FFB546); box-shadow: 0 0 0.75rem var(--lamp-glow, rgba(255,181,70,0.30)); }

components.name: Connection Indicator
components.description: The first thing read on the surface: round lamp, uppercase status word, host address at the right edge. Live is amber with a glow; fault turns both lamp and word red, so state never rests on hue alone.
components.css: .ds-ind { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 1rem 1.125rem 0.875rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); color: var(--ink, #E9E6DF); font: 400 1rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ind-lamp { width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--lamp, #FFB546); box-shadow: 0 0 0.5rem var(--lamp-glow, rgba(255,181,70,0.30)); } .ds-ind-state { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ind-host { margin-left: auto; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--ink-faint, #7C818B); }

components.name: Compose Input
components.description: The one text field in the system; it hands typing to the iPhone's own keyboard. The 16px size is load-bearing because anything smaller makes iOS zoom the page.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 2.75rem; min-width: 0; padding: 0 0.75rem; background: var(--field, #15161A); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); color: var(--ink, #E9E6DF); font: 400 1rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--lamp, #FFB546); accent-color: var(--ink-dim, #878D99); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint, #7C818B); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lamp, #FFB546); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: App Tile
components.description: A tile in the four-column running-app grid. The frontmost app takes an amber border and label; the same engagement vocabulary, without a glow at tile scale.
components.css: .ds-app { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.25rem; background: var(--field, #15161A); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); color: var(--ink-faint, #7C818B); font: 400 0.6875rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-app img { width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; } .ds-app span { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-app[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--lamp, #FFB546); color: var(--lamp, #FFB546); } .ds-app:active { background: var(--field-down, #1F212733); }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A bottom-anchored panel on the plate colour, closed by a single seam along the top. The one eased moment in the system: 220ms slide from translateY(110%).
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--plate, #0B0B0D); border-top: 1px solid var(--seam, #23252B); padding: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink, #E9E6DF); transform: translateY(110%); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1); } .ds-sheet[data-open="yes"] { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0 0.25rem 0.625rem; } .ds-sheet-head h2 { flex: 1; font: 600 0.6875rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-dim, #878D99); margin: 0; }

components.name: Gesture Flash
components.description: The full-bleed confirmation printed across the pad when a multi-finger gesture fires. The only element in the system that transitions opacity, at the 90ms step.
components.css: .ds-flash { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 4rem; background: var(--lamp-wash, rgba(255,181,70,0.07)); color: var(--lamp, #FFB546); font: 600 0.875rem/1.3 -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 90ms linear; } .ds-flash[data-show="yes"] { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
MacPad is a control plate, not an app screen. Everything in it is built from the discipline of a lift call panel: targets you can hit without aiming, a single lamp colour that means exactly one thing, and a spatial rhythm the thumb memorises so the eye can stay on the Mac. The plate is engraved, never moulded -- surfaces are separated by a one-pixel seam and a single step of luminance, and the only inner detail on the trackpad is a hairline rule set 10px in from its edge, which makes the field read as a plate rather than a card.

Light and dark are both first-class, not a theme and its override. The product is used in a dark room with the Mac on a TV and at a lit desk, so the stylesheet declares color-scheme: dark light and ships a complete daylight twin with identical geometry on a warm-neutral plate (#E7E5E2) that shares the dark twin's warm axis. Neither scheme is a default and neither is the "real" one.

Density is deliberately low. One primary target size (52px) governs every control the thumb must hit, a 44px floor governs the compact keys and secondary buttons inside sheets, and controls that rearrange the Mac are separated from the rest by real empty space rather than a divider line. The system refuses the category default -- the dark grey slab with a featureless pad and a row of undersized icon buttons -- and it equally refuses brushed-metal skeuomorphism: there are no bevels, no gloss, no gradients and no metal bezels anywhere in the build. Type is the platform sans; the typographic work is carried by scale, wide tracking and tabular figures, because the page is served over the LAN with no internet and no dependency.
keyCharacteristics: Engraved flatness: one luminance step plus a 1px seam does all the separating.
Two co-equal schemes, identical geometry, one warm axis.
One chromatic colour (amber), reserved entirely for "engaged".
52px primary target, 44px floor, air between banks.
Nothing eases except one 220ms sheet slide and one 260ms lamp warm.
Flat corners: a single 5px radius, plus a round indicator lamp.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only chromatic colour and it means engaged, nothing else. It is never used for emphasis, branding, decoration or hierarchy. If more than a couple of elements on screen are amber at once, the lamp has stopped meaning anything.

rules.name: The Luminance-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: State changes move within one palette. A control that engages goes brighter and warmer; it never swaps to a different hue family, and it never carries its state in colour alone -- the pressed key shifts border, text, background and ring together.

rules.name: The Two-Step Rule
rules.body: Depth is exactly two values: plate and field, one luminance step apart, divided by a 1px seam. There is no third surface level and no shadow doing the dividing.

rules.name: The No-Display-Type Rule
rules.body: There is no hero size and no heading ramp. The largest text in the system is 17px. Nothing on this surface is to be read from across the room; the Mac's screen is the output.

rules.name: The Tracking-Carries-It Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase text earns its authority from tracking, which widens as the text gets smaller and more structural: 0.04em on legend terms, 0.12em on keycaps, 0.16em on the status readout, 0.2em on sheet titles.

rules.name: The Hardware-Glyph Rule
rules.body: Command, Control, Option, Shift and Return-class symbols are typed characters, never drawn icons, because they are the symbols printed on the user's own keyboard. Everything else pictorial is an SVG from the sprite.

rules.name: The Pad Is Never Covered Rule
rules.body: The trackpad keeps a usable height no matter what is open. CSS floors it at 8.5rem; JavaScript recomputes an open sheet's max-height against a 150px pad floor and the indicator's height, and lifts the sheet above the system keyboard using visualViewport.

rules.name: The Shed-Before-Shrink Rule
rules.body: When a sheet opens, the pad drops its legend and the banks hide entirely rather than let the pad compress into a card. Content is given up before geometry is.

rules.name: The Bottom-Reach Rule
rules.body: Panel openers (Apps, Keyboard, Settings) live in the last bank at the bottom of the column, because the top corners are the hardest reach for a thumb. Frequency orders the banks; reach orders the column.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: No bevel, no chrome, no gloss, no gradient, no drop shadow. The plate is engraved, not moulded. Any shadow in this system is zero-offset and amber, which makes it light rather than depth.

rules.name: The Glow Is Never Alone Rule
rules.body: The lamp halo is a deliberate, named exception to the usual prohibition on zero-offset glows, and it is only legitimate because it is always reinforced: engagement sets border-colour, text-colour and background wash alongside the glow, so the state survives on a surface where the glow is invisible.

rules.name: The One Radius Rule
rules.body: 5px everywhere, or a full circle for a lamp. There is no radius scale, no pill and no square-cornered exception.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every division in the system is exactly 1px of seam colour. Weight is never used to signal importance; a division is a division.

dos: Do give every thumb target the primary floor (52px / var(--target)) and never go below 44px for a secondary control inside a sheet.
Do carry engaged state with the full lamp ring -- border, text, wash and glow together -- so the state never depends on the glow alone.
Do use a 1px seam border for every division, and a 5px radius for every rectangular surface.
Do separate a disruptive control with real empty space (20px bank margin), not with a divider line.
Do ship any new token into both schemes at once; dark and light are co-equal, and the daylight twin keeps identical geometry on a warm-neutral plate.
Do keep state landing in two frames (--step: 90ms linear). The only eased moments in the system are the 220ms sheet slide and the 260ms lamp warm, both inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Do set hardware modifier symbols as type, and everything else pictorial as a 1.6-stroke 24x24 sprite icon.
Do keep the pad usable at all times: cap sheets against the pad floor and drop the legend before the pad shrinks.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces from the palette -- selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbar, accent-color, tabular numerals.
donts: Don't introduce a second chromatic colour, or spend amber on anything other than "engaged". Fault red is the single exception and it is reserved for disconnection.
Don't add a bevel, gloss, gradient, metal bezel or offset drop shadow. Every shadow in this system is a zero-offset amber glow or an inset amber ring.
Don't signal state with hue. Engagement is luminance within one palette.
Don't add a radius scale. 5px, or a circle for a lamp.
Don't add a display size or a heading ramp. 17px is the largest type in the system.
Don't attach meaning to hover; the surface is touch-only and hover never fires.
Don't draw a QWERTY keyboard. Text entry is the iPhone's own keyboard; the sheet supplies only what iOS cannot send to a Mac.
Don't let a sheet cover the trackpad, or let the pad compress into a card to make room.
Don't add a webfont, icon font or any third-party asset. The page must load over the LAN with no internet, which is why the platform sans ships.
Don't animate an engaged state on. The ring appears in two frames and stays as long as the state is held.
